name: Neon Words & Symbols
description: 38 neon word and symbol levels: eleven word designs and twenty-seven cultural and FPV symbols. Each arena has distinctive terrain, passages, refuges and enemies. Custom reveal images are planned; existing procedural retro artwork is used for now.

metadata.author: RevealLine
metadata.rightsStatus: User-supplied layout references with original procedural placeholder sprites. Custom reveal images are deferred; no source screenshot artwork or music embedded.

classRecipes.label: FPV Scout
classRecipes.description: A nimble FPV quad. Scan shows enemy direction hints for four seconds; it never captures territory or slows an enemy.

metadata.description: Red pixel lettering spells FPV. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Offset garden courts surround the motif, with tidal coves along the lower route. 3 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 7 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
